title: 第十五章 暗留后手旧账初查第十六章 魍魉暗作祟轻手破阴私
lines: 一夜悄然而过，相府的气氛彻底换了模样。
往日里下人做事懒散、处处敷衍的模样全然不见，晨起洒扫、各司其职，动作利落规整。谁都清楚如今府中做主的是沈清鸢，再也不敢仗着从前柳氏的情面偷奸耍滑。
汀兰院里，晨光透过窗棂洒落在桌案，映着摊开的厚厚账本。沈清鸢端坐案前，指尖一笔笔核对账目，眉目沉静。
春桃立在一旁研墨，看着密密麻麻的收支明细，忍不住低声感慨：“小姐，这柳姨娘也太贪了。往年府中采买、田地收成、铺面盈利，处处都有虚账，一笔笔全是水分。”
沈清鸢指尖点在一行旧账上，眼底泛着冷光。
她接手中馈不过一日，便查出数十笔不明支出。大多是以府中应酬、修缮院落、添置家当为由支取银两，最后尽数不知所踪。尤其是生母遗留的几间京城旺铺，近三年的分红账目干净得离谱，分明是被人暗中私吞，刻意抹平了痕迹。
“她掌家十几年，早就把相府当成自己的私囊。”沈清鸢缓缓开口，“最关键的不是这些零碎银两，是我母亲留下的产业，大半都被她暗中转移、更名，藏得极深。”
一旁侍立的张嬷嬷闻言，眼眶又是一红：“老奴还记得，当年主母留下整整十二间临街铺面、两处良田庄子，皆是京中上等富庶产业。柳氏进门之后，借着打理嫁妆的由头，一点点接手，逐年挪走，当年还有不少老仆撞见，只是没人敢出声。”
这些年柳氏一手遮天，谁敢多嘴，轻则被打骂责罚，重则直接发卖、发配农庄，久而久之，所有人都只能装聋作哑。
沈清鸢合上账本，指尖轻轻敲击封皮。
账目破绽虽多，但柳氏心思缜密，关键的资产转移全都做得极为隐蔽，没有实打实的地契、铺面契约佐证，就算当众揭发，她也能百般抵赖。
“不急。”沈清鸢淡淡道，“慢慢来，一笔一笔查，一桩一桩清算。她藏得再深，也终有露破绽的那天。”
正当院内安静对账之时，凝香院看似死寂封闭，内里却藏着暗流涌动。
院门被锁，下人被调换，看似彻底被禁足，可柳氏在相府经营十几年，暗中培养的亲信旧部极多，绝非一朝一夕能够根除。
此刻屋内，柳氏褪去了所有温婉伪装，面色阴沉沉的，指尖紧紧攥着一张泛黄的薄纸。
那是几张私藏的田产地契，都是她早年悄悄转移、更名到自己亲信名下的私产，不属相府公账，就连沈敬山都一无所知。
沈轻柔蜷缩在一旁，依旧惶恐不安：“娘亲，我们如今被关在这里，下人全是外人盯着，还有什么翻盘的机会？不如我们认个错，求爹爹和祖母原谅吧……”
“认错？”柳氏转头瞪她，眼底满是恨铁不成钢，“认错就能回到从前？就能拿回管家权？就能让你压过沈清鸢？天真！”
“今日我们认输，往后一辈子都要被沈清鸢踩在脚下！她本就恨我们母女，等她查清旧账，查到当年主母的死因，我们母女二人必死无疑！”
经历过昨日的惨败，柳氏彻底清醒。
她和沈清鸢早已是不死不休的局面，退让只有死路一条，唯有反扑，才有生机。
她压低声音，语气狠戾：“我早已留了后手。府里后厨的刘管事、外院的马夫头，都是我一手提拔起来的亲信，就算换了下人看守，他们依旧能悄悄传信。”
“太子只是禁足，并未废位。只要等风波平息，我再暗中递信东宫，只要太子重新掌权，我们就还有翻身之日。沈清鸢现在风头正盛，越是耀眼，越容易摔得粉身碎骨。”
沈轻柔听着，慌乱的心稍稍安定，眼底重新燃起一丝贪婪的火光。
content_en:
One night passed quietly, and the atmosphere in the Prime Minister's Mansion completely changed.
In the past, the servants' laziness and perfunctory attitude were completely gone. When they got up in the morning, they swept and performed their duties with neat and orderly movements. Everyone knows that Shen Qingyuan is the one who calls the shots in the house now, and they no longer dare to rely on Liu's favor in the past to cheat.
In Tinglan Courtyard, the morning light shines through the window lattice on the table, reflecting the thick account books spread out. Shen Qingyuan sat in front of the case, checking the accounts with his fingertips, his eyebrows calm.
Chuntao stood aside and studied ink. Looking at the dense details of income and expenditure, she couldn't help but sigh in a low voice: "Miss, this Aunt Liu is too greedy. In the past years, there were false accounts everywhere in the government's purchases, field harvests, and shop profits. Every brushstroke was full of water."
Shen Qingyuan's fingertips touched a row of old accounts, with a cold light in his eyes.
Within one day of taking over the business, she discovered dozens of unexplained expenditures. Most of the money was withdrawn on the pretext of entertaining in the mansion, repairing the courtyard, and purchasing property, but in the end all of them disappeared. Especially for the few prosperous shops in the capital left by her birth mother, the dividend accounts for the past three years were ridiculously clean. It was clear that they had been embezzled secretly and the traces were deliberately smoothed out.
"She has been in charge of the family for more than ten years, and she has long regarded the Prime Minister's Palace as her own private pocket." Shen Qingyuan said slowly, "The most important thing is not these bits and pieces of silver, but the property left by my mother. Most of it was secretly transferred, renamed, and deeply hidden by her."
Nanny Zhang, who was standing by, heard this, and her eyes turned red again: "Old slave, I still remember that my mistress left twelve street-facing shops and two farmland villages, all of which were high-end and wealthy properties in the capital. After Mrs. Liu came in, she took over bit by bit and moved them away year by year under the pretext of taking care of the dowry. Many old servants bumped into her back then, but no one dared to say anything."
In the past few years, the Liu family has been covering the sky with one hand. Anyone who dares to talk will be beaten, scolded and punished, or directly sold and distributed to the farm. Over time, everyone can only pretend to be deaf and dumb.
Shen Qingyuan closed the ledger and tapped the cover lightly with her fingertips.
Although there are many flaws in the accounts, Ms. Liu is very thoughtful and makes all key asset transfers extremely concealed. There is no actual land deed or shop contract to prove it. Even if she is exposed in public, she can deny it in every possible way.
"There is no rush." Shen Qingyuan said calmly, "Take your time, check one by one, and liquidate one by one. No matter how deep she hides, the day will come when her flaws will be exposed."
While the courtyard was quietly checking accounts, Ningxiang Courtyard seemed dead and closed, but there was an undercurrent lurking inside.
The courtyard door was locked, the servants were replaced, and it seemed that they were completely banned. However, the Liu family had been operating in the Prime Minister's Mansion for more than ten years, and had secretly cultivated many old cronies, which could not be eradicated overnight.
At this moment in the room, Ms. Liu had lost all her gentle pretense, her face was gloomy, and her fingertips were tightly holding a piece of yellowed tissue paper.
Those were several private property deeds that she had secretly transferred and renamed to the names of her cronies in the early years. They were not part of the public accounts of the Prime Minister's Office, and even Shen Jingshan knew nothing about them.
Shen Qingrou huddled aside, still feeling uneasy: "Mother, we are locked up here now, and all the servants are being watched by outsiders. What chance is there for us to make a comeback? Why don't we admit our mistake and ask father and grandmother to forgive..."
"Admit your mistake?" Mrs. Liu turned to glare at her, her eyes full of hatred. "Can you go back to the past if you admit your mistake? Can you get back the housekeeper's rights? Can you be more powerful than Shen Qingyuan? So naive!"
"Today we admit defeat, and we will be trampled under Shen Qingyuan's feet for the rest of our lives! She already hates us mother and daughter. When she clears up the old accounts and finds out the cause of mistress's death, we, mother and daughter, will definitely die!"
After experiencing yesterday's fiasco, Liu was completely sober.
She and Shen Qingyuan were already in a fight to the death. Giving in would only lead to death, and only counterattack would give them hope.
She lowered her voice and said in a cruel tone: "I have already left a backup. Manager Liu in the kitchen and the groom in the outer courtyard are all my trusted followers. Even if there are different servants to guard them, they can still send messages quietly."
"The prince is only grounded, not dethroned. As long as the storm subsides, I will secretly send a letter to the East Palace. As long as the prince returns to power, we will have a chance to turn around. Shen Qingyuan is currently in the limelight. The more dazzling he is, the easier it will be to fall to pieces."
As Shen Qingrou listened, her panicked heart calmed down a little, and a greedy fire reignited in her eyes.
title_en: Chapter 15: Preliminary investigation of old accounts that were kept behind the scenes Chapter 16: Demons and ghosts are working secretly to reveal secrets with ease
